products.name: Glasshand
products.tagline: Give your agent a real iPhone and Mac
products.description: Glasshand gives your AI agents real iPhones and Macs to work on. Connect Claude Code, Codex, or any other agent, and it can rent a device with a single prompt. The hardware sits in our data center, and your agent uses it the way you would: posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for as long as you rent it. When you’re done, we erase your data and factory-reset it.

products.name: Living Brain
products.tagline: Interoperable, efficient memory layer for agentic AI
products.description: Every AI conversation contains knowledge worth keeping, but most of it gets trapped in separate chats and tools. Living Brain captures that knowledge, connects it to what you already know, and turns it into a persistent memory that keeps evolving. Share that intelligence across AI models, apps, and agents through API, SDK, or MCP, so every new interaction builds on the last instead of starting over. Reuse memory across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, Codex and more

products.name: Rerun
products.tagline: Turn your AI subscriptions into a team of coworkers
products.description: Rerun turns your ChatGPT or Claude subscription into a team of AI coworkers. Each one has tools, a computer and a shared workspace, runs on a schedule or a trigger, and asks before risky actions. Now open-source (AGPL v3) and self-hostable.

products.name: Pushary for Teams
products.tagline: See who said yes to your team’s AI agents
products.description: When an AI agent stops to ask permission, Pushary sends the question to the person running it, in their Mac’s notch or on their phone. Lee’s agent asks Lee. Sam’s agent asks Sam. A rule can send a push to your infra repo to your lead instead. Answers from the phone, Mac app and dashboard are saved with a name, so when something breaks, one page shows whose agent asked and who said yes. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Agy and Hermes.

products.name: Maritime
products.tagline: Cloud computers for any AI agent, customized your way
products.description: Maritime gives AI agents their own cloud computers: persistent workspaces, disposable sandboxes, Linux and Windows desktops, and Android phones. Agents can run code, use browsers, and work in apps without APIs, with a human able to take over when needed. Whether you’re building a personal assistant or running thousands of tasks in parallel, Maritime handles the computers so you can focus on what your agent does.

products.name: Clocknext
products.tagline: Pricing and Billing Infrastructure for AI Agents
products.description: Clocknext is a billing and monetization platform for AI-native apps and agents. It’s tailored for AI founders, revenue, and engineering teams, to track AI usage from your product in real time, turn it into billable metrics with flexible pricing plans, and monitor costs, margins, and profitability at every level.

products.name: Bridge
products.tagline: Video conferencing for the agentic era
products.description: This launch marks a new era for Bridge: one agentic meeting platform replacing the fragmented meeting stack. Bridge now brings scheduling pages, automatic preparation, video conferencing, live intelligence, AI notetaking, agentic workflows, and structured memory into one connected experience for people and agents. At the center of this launch is a new kind of video conferencing built for customizable AI agents to join and participant in meetings.

products.name: Tao Browser
products.tagline: Private browser with a separate login for every company
products.description: Tao Browser keeps each company, client or project in its own space with its own cookies and logins. Lock tabs with Face ID or Touch ID, block ads and trackers on your device, import from Arc. No account, no telemetry. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac (beta).

products.name: Rainbrand
products.description: Rainbrand builds and maintains shared brand context from your websites, brand guides and files. Give your agents the guidance and assets they need for marketing campaigns, websites, slides, email, video, and more. Keep that context current as your brands evolve. Use it with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or Cursor, or build it into your product through the API.

products.name: Stitch.ai
products.tagline: Your AI workspace for mail, calendar, notes, tasks and more
products.description: Stitch.ai brings mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes, sheets, slides, boards, and files into one connected workspace. Stitchy, your AI assistant, works with you across it all. Dual workspace panels allow you to drag, drop, and Stitch anything to everything. Nothing gets lost. AI-powered Knots, Tags, and Connections keep your work organized and easy to surface. Everything is built in: no integrations or extra email clients to set up. Get your work done in one place, without losing context.

products.name: Polylane for Google Cloud
products.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Google Cloud apps
products.description: Ship with confidence on Google Cloud. Polylane investigates issues in your apps, shows you what went wrong and what it affects, and prepares a fix for you to review. Get answers without digging through logs and dashboards, so you can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

products.name: Wingmen
products.tagline: Agentic outreach with real intent data
products.description: Wingmen finds people already showing they need what you sell: a post about the problem, a new hire, a job change. It scores who's worth reaching and why, writes the opener from what they actually said, and follows up on autopilot until there's a call on your calendar. Run it in the web app or straight from Claude with the Wingmen MCP. Built for founders, B2B teams and agencies.

products.name: FounderMail
products.tagline: Mail for you and your agents, on your Cloudflare domain
products.description: Real email on the domains you already run on Cloudflare, without paying per seat or forwarding to Gmail. You, your team and your AI agents work from the same inbox, and agents get their own access instead of your password.

products.name: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
products.tagline: Intelligent Transcription with a Speech LLM
products.description: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open speech LLM for intelligent transcription: a single model that transcribes 40 languages verbatim or in written form, with context, speaker attribution, and word timestamps, selected with a natural language instruction. It is the best open-weights model on the English and multilingual Open ASR Leaderboards.

products.name: Tencent Hy4
products.tagline: Tencent’s flagship model learns to see and use a computer
products.description: Hy4 is Tencent’s latest flagship model, aimed at office tasks, financial analysis and game development. New since the preview, per Tencent: visual understanding for charts and images, and computer use across command line and graphical interfaces, with training on Blender and CAD. Tencent says the internal hallucination rate fell from 12.95% to 7.2%. Available on Tencent Cloud TokenHub, OpenRouter and Tencent apps. Weights are promised in the coming days.
